tool.name: Q-Force – Group chat
tool.description: Several assistants discuss a topic in turn, with brakes and a summary.
tool.long_description: In the group chat several connected assistants discuss a topic in turn, each with an optional role. Brakes keep it under control: rounds, contributions, length, time and tokens, a pause per round, stop on agreement or repetition. You can interject at any time; at the end an assistant writes a summary. Per-minute limits of the providers are respected (Q-Force waits and keeps a distance). Pseudonymization is applied before sending.
grp.title: Group chat
grp.no_bot: No assistant is connected for the group chat yet. Set up connections under Settings > AI assistants.
grp.intro: Several assistants discuss a topic in turn. Set participants, topic and brakes, then start. While it runs you can interject or pause at any time.
grp.col.name: Name
grp.topic_hint: What is it about? e.g. "Plan the migration of the clients to Windows 12 – risks and order."
grp.summary: The first participant summarizes at the end
grp.opt.pause_each_round: Pause after each round and wait for "Continue"
grp.opt.stop_on_agree: Stop when everyone in a round is done (agreement)
grp.opt.stop_on_repeat: Stop when a participant repeats itself
grp.privacy: There are no function calls: the assistants only see the topic, your interjections and the contributions of the others. Pseudonymization follows this tool's "AI access" setting (addresses and names are replaced before sending). Group chats are stored like chats and encrypted if configured.
grp.interject_hint: Interjection to the group (inserted before the next contribution) …
grp.queued: Interjection queued – it comes before the next contribution.
grp.need_participants: Please add at least one participant with an assistant.
grp.missing_conn: The connection of {name} no longer exists.
grp.end.max_messages: Brake: maximum number of contributions reached.
grp.reuse: Use as template for a new group chat
grp.unreadable: The group chat cannot be read (encrypted with another key or damaged).
grp.wait: {who}: the provider's per-minute limit was reached. Continuing automatically in {seconds} s; after that the group chat leaves more time between requests to this provider.
